Omnia 11048 Mortise Lockset

This is the Omnia 11000 series back plate with the #47 satin stainless lever. Omnia's mortise locksets are for residential and commercial use. Built to withstand heavy use, the commercial grade, UL listed, and fire rated mortise lock combines precision engineering for security and durability with attractive design. The backplates feature a unique inside-to-outside mounting with screw-less outside plates.

Panic Proof Entry: Latchbolt operates by lever from either side except when outside trim is locked by stop-button. Deadbolt activated by key outside and by turnpiece inside. Turning inside lever will retract both deadbolt and latchbolt at the same time.

Specifications for the Omnia 11047 Mortise Set:

  • Finish: Satin Nickel/Satin Stainless
  • Backset: 2-3/4"
  • Solid Brass Levers and Trim
  • Tough, non rusting materials used throughout.
  • Mortise case is heavy wrought steel with zinc dichromate finish for corrosion resistance.
  • Front: Adjustable armored steel front, with 8" x 1-1/4" solid brass faceplate for all lock bodies, finished to match trim.
  • Deadbolt: Full 1" Throw, Solid Brass with Saw-proof Insert.
  • Lock Cylinder: Standard "C" keyway supplied with two nickel silver keys.
  • Handing: Left hand

Sold Individually

Custom Ordered Item. No Returns.
